apply.heroDesc: This is your first step toward a WorkforceAP program. Share a little about yourself, pick a program that interests you — or tell us you're not sure yet — and a member advisor will follow up within 1–2 business days to walk you through your options.
apply.heroDescHighlight: Programs are offered at no cost to qualifying members, funded by grants and partnerships.
apply.heroDescSuffix: No prior experience required. We'll help you confirm fit and eligibility for next steps.

apply.nextStep1: Submit your application and tell us what kind of work or training you want.
apply.nextStep2: A WorkforceAP advisor reviews your information and follows up within 1–2 business days in most cases.
apply.nextStep3: We talk through fit, eligibility, and the best next step for your situation.
apply.nextStep4: If needed, we guide you to screening, documentation, interview, or program-readiness steps.
apply.nextStep5: You get a clearer recommendation for training, support, and job-readiness next steps.

apply.suppCard2Body: A member advisor reviews every application within 1–2 business days in most cases and reaches out to help you find the right program fit.

home.aboutTitle: Employer-Aligned Training. Career Support Throughout the Journey.
home.aboutBody1: WorkforceAP is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit built in Austin on 25+ years of workforce development experience and a recurring Vision given to Michael Brown by God for serving His people. WorkforceAP combines employer-aligned training, AI workforce readiness and soft-skill support, occupational training, and career guidance in a model built to work and scale — with no cost to qualifying members.
home.aboutBody2: Our leadership brings experience from the Texas Workforce Commission, Workforce Solutions, the City of Austin, ReWork America Alliance, Consulting Solutions.Net, Goodwill Central Texas, Austin Area Urban League, Apprentice Now, Austin Urban Technology Movement, Universal Tech Movement, and African American Youth Harvest Foundation. Through grants and partner-backed pathways, we support members with resume help, interview prep, job-search guidance, and career support from first step to placement.
home.journeySubtitle: From first application through training and job readiness, WorkforceAP breaks the process into clear steps so you know what happens next.
home.programsSubtitle: Career training that prepares you for jobs employers are hiring for right now.
home.aiTitle: Resume Feedback in Minutes, Not Days
home.aiCopy: Members get AI tools that sharpen your resume, build your elevator speech, practice interviews with questions specific to your target role, and track progress inside the member portal.
home.ctaCopy: About 10 minutes to apply. We respond within 1–2 business days. Industry-recognized certificates and placement support. No-cost for qualifying members.

whatWeDo.description: WorkforceAP is built on 25+ years of workforce development leadership. Employer-aligned training, career support, and grant- and partner-funded access for qualifying members.

whatWeDo.heroCopy: Employer-aligned training. No cost for qualifying members. Career support throughout the journey. A model that works — and scales.
whatWeDo.bento1Desc: Training programs shaped with employer input — Google, IBM, AWS, Microsoft, CompTIA — so credentials map to real hiring needs.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.description: Your path from application through certification and job placement. Ten clear steps — each designed to set you up for success.
howItWorks.heroCopy: No gatekeeping. Clear, grant- and partner-funded pathways for qualifying members. Just a guided process — from your first conversation with us to your first day on the job (and beyond).
howItWorks.whoCanApplyBody: WorkforceAP is designed for adults who face barriers to employment — including low-income individuals, people with employment gaps, those with limited or no formal work history, justice-involved individuals, dislocated workers, veterans, and adult learners seeking a career change. WIOA eligibility can unlock additional funding.
howItWorks.journeySubtitle: Ten steps, three phases. Every step has a purpose — and a person supporting you through it.
howItWorks.videoCaption: Prefer to read? The summary below is always available.
howItWorks.laptopBody: Access to technology shouldn't be a barrier to education. We provide high-performance laptops to members who need them for the duration of their training program.
howItWorks.laptopItem3: No upfront program cost for qualifying members
howItWorks.support150Body: We don't just find you a job; we help you keep it. Our support continues for five months after your start date.
howItWorks.training1Desc: Approved certification tracks and technical bootcamps are funded through grants and partnerships.
howItWorks.training2Desc: Access to an exclusive community of members and alumni for mentorship and networking.
howItWorks.training3Desc: Support connecting to openings shared through our employer network and placement efforts.
howItWorks.training4Desc: Dedicated sessions on leadership, communication, and emotional intelligence.
howItWorks.ctaTitle: Ready to take the first step?
howItWorks.ctaBody: The application takes about ten minutes. It's a conversation, not an exam — and there's no application fee.

leadership.description: Meet the leadership team behind WorkforceAP — decades of workforce experience, employer-side tech credibility, military discipline, and nationwide community impact.
leadership.governanceBody: Our governance team combines decades of workforce development leadership, employer-side tech credibility, military and operations discipline, and deep community roots — connecting workforce training to real outcomes across the nation.
leadership.quote: This isn't a generic nonprofit team. These are people who've run programs at scale, led at Goodwill and Urban League, built systems at IBM and Microsoft, commanded in the Army and at AWS — and who show up nationwide.

faq.heroCopy: Answers that address your concerns, whether you're applying, supporting someone who is, or deciding if WorkforceAP is right for you.
faq.quickAnswersTitle: Start with the questions people ask most.
faq.faq1q: How much do WorkforceAP programs cost?
faq.faq1a: Programs are offered at no cost to qualifying members. WorkforceAP helps you understand the funding path, eligibility, and next step before you commit.
faq.faq2q: Do I need prior tech experience?
faq.faq2a: No. Many members start from zero. If computers still feel new, there are beginner-safe options designed to help you build confidence first.
faq.faq3a: WorkforceAP reviews your goals, confirms fit, and follows up with next steps. That can include intake guidance, documentation review, or program-specific support.
faq.faq4a: Most programs take about 3–5 months at roughly 10 hours per week. Digital Literacy is shorter and works well as an on-ramp if you need a gentler start.

contact.heroCopy: Whether you're a current or prospective member with program questions, an employer looking to hire or build a pipeline, a community partner exploring a referral relationship, or a donor interested in supporting no-cost member training, reach out and a WorkforceAP team member will respond within 1–2 business days.
contact.card4Body: We reply within 1–2 business days for most inquiries.
contact.austinTitle: Built in Austin, supporting members nationwide
contact.austinBody: We work from Austin, Texas and support members, partners, and employers across the country. Use the form, email, or phone to reach the right WorkforceAP team member. We coordinate with partner organizations, but counselors and partner organizations are not the same thing.
contact.quote: We believe everyone deserves a clear path to a meaningful career. That starts with being available and responsive to the people we serve.

partners.title: Community & Employer Partners
partners.description: Partner with WorkforceAP: employers hire talent, referral orgs send candidates, workforce boards align, funders support scale. Clear next steps for each.
partners.heroCopy: Refer members, track outcomes, and get paid. Employers, workforce boards, and funders each have a clear path too.
partners.narrativeQuote: We partner with employers who hire, orgs who refer, workforce boards who align, and funders who scale. Each partnership type has a clear path — because building a skilled workforce takes all of us working together.
partners.narrativeCopy: Referral partners send us candidates who may benefit from career training offered at no cost to members. We reach out within 24–48 hours and walk them through the process. We welcome referrals of individuals motivated to improve the quality of their life and interested in training in technology, healthcare, manufacturing, or skilled trades.
partners.narrativeLi1: Submit a referral via our contact form or partner portal
partners.narrativeLi2: We contact the candidate within 24–48 hours
partners.narrativeLi3: Accepted members receive training, certificates, and job placement support
partners.narrativeLi4: You receive updates when referred individuals complete programs
partners.ctaCopy: Clear next steps, real outcomes, and a team that follows up within 1–2 business days.
partners.signupSubtitle: Refer members, track outcomes, get paid. Submit the form — we activate your partner portal within 1–2 business days.
partners.signupOtherPaths: Training centers, public agencies, and funders:
partners.signupContactTeam: contact us for the right path
partners.referralWho: Nonprofits, social services, churches, reentry programs, community centers, workforce centers, federal one-stop centers.
partners.referralWhy: Refer clients who need career training. We follow up within 1-2 business days. There is no cost to refer. You get updates when referred individuals complete programs.
partners.trainingWho: Educational institutions, community colleges, vocational schools, digital literacy centers.
partners.trainingWhy: Co-deliver employer-recognized certification programs. We bring the employer pipeline; you bring the learning environment.
partners.agencyWho: Workforce Solutions, TWC, WIOA providers, government workforce programs.
partners.agencyWhy: Align your participants with employer-recognized in-demand certifications. We handle training and placement; you strengthen outcomes for your population.
partners.funderWho: Foundations, corporate giving, impact investors, individual donors.
partners.funderWhy: Fund a model that works. Employer-aligned training, no participant debt, measurable job outcomes. We're growing nationwide and building toward national scale.
partners.platformFeature1Desc: Structured enrollment and eligibility screening reduces onboarding time by 60%, letting counselors focus on high-touch support.
partners.platformFeature2Desc: Partners access live data on referral status, enrollment progress, certification completions, and placement outcomes.
partners.platformFeature3Desc: Automated credential verification and WIOA-compliant reporting ensures accountability across every partnership.
partners.faq1a: Employers, workforce development boards, non-profit services, churches, community organizations, social service agencies, and educational institutions can partner with WorkforceAP to refer candidates or hire graduates.
partners.faq2q: Is there a cost to refer candidates?
partners.faq2a: No. There is no cost to refer someone. We welcome partners who want to connect individuals in their network with our career training programs that are offered at no cost to members.
partners.faq3a: Use the referral partner registration form on this page to get a partner portal and referral link. You can also email info@workforceap.org or call (512) 777-1808 with the candidate's name and contact information.
partners.faq4a: Yes. We actively connect employers with job-ready graduates. Reach out to discuss your hiring needs and we can share candidate profiles and schedule introductions.
partners.faq5a: Partners receive regular updates on referral status, program completion rates, and placement outcomes. Our digital platform provides real-time dashboards for tracking progress.

employers.description: Access pre-screened, certified tech talent. WorkforceAP graduates hold industry credentials from Google, IBM, AWS, CompTIA. Post jobs or become a hiring partner. Serving employers nationwide.
employers.waitlistCopy: We're focused on placing our first cohort right now. Hire-now applications are welcome below — we'll match you with certified candidates as they finish their programs. Hiring volume scales over the next two cohorts.
employers.heroCopy: Start the employer intake with your hiring use case, role needs, volume, and timeline. We will route you to the right partnership path and follow up with matched talent options.

employers.valueCard2Desc: Access talent from underserved communities, adult learners, and veterans — bringing fresh perspectives and resilience to your teams.
employers.valueCard3Desc: 150-day onboarding support for every hire. We help your new team members succeed long-term, not just on day one.

accessibility.description: Read Workforce Advancement Project accessibility commitments and how to request help using the site.
accessibility.heading: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Workforce Advancement Project works to make this site easier to use for members, partners, employers, and community supporters. We aim to provide clear content, readable layouts, keyboard-usable navigation, and mobile-friendly access on slow devices and limited connections.
accessibility.helpTitle: If you need help using this site
accessibility.helpCopy: If you run into a barrier while using WorkforceAP.org, contact us and we will do our best to provide the information or support you need in another format.
accessibility.improvementsCopy1: We continue improving content clarity, color contrast, tap targets, and responsive behavior across public and member-facing pages.
accessibility.improvementsCopy2: If something is hard to read, navigate, or complete, please tell us. That feedback helps us improve access for the people this work is meant to serve.
